    ? forall n Z:
        (n*(n+1))%2 = 0

    n%2 = 0 or n%2 = 1
    by cases:
        ? (n*(n+1))%2 = 0
        case n%2 = 0:
            n = 2*q+n%2 = 2*q
            n*(n+1) = (2*q)*(n+1) = 2*(q*(n+1))
            (n*(n+1))%2 = (2*(q*(n+1)))%2 = 0
        case n%2 = 1:
            n = 2*q+n%2 = 2*q+1
            n+1 = 2*q+1+1 = 2*(q+1)
            n*(n+1) = n*(2*(q+1)) = 2*(n*(q+1))
            (n*(n+1))%2 = (2*(n*(q+1)))%2 = 0
